concept: A numbered mark after a claim that opens a small card with the source, the passage and a link, so a claim can be checked before acting on it.

default_to_avoid.pattern: a citation as a blue underlined superscript number
default_to_avoid.kind: citation, source link, footnote, reference marker
default_to_avoid.why_not: a blue superscript is a hue and a tiny target; Pane makes a round mark with a 24px press area and puts the source in words

derivation.consequence: selected and pressed states change shape or add a mark (a check, a ring), never only colour
derivation.form: the mark is a small round chip in the line, sized to its number

derivation.consequence: keyboard reaches everything a pointer can, with a visible focus ring on any backdrop
derivation.form: its name says the source in words, and it opens a card on press or Enter

derivation.consequence: light falls from above, so every surface carries a rim brightest along its top edge and a soft shadow below that says where it floats, and a recess is the inverse, shaded under its top lip and lit on its bottom lip; a nested surface adds no second blur, because one sheet of glass is one layer
derivation.form: the card is a level-4 pane over the answer

options: A round chip that opens a card
C a sources list at the end only
variants.picked: A round chip that opens a card
variants.reason: A checks a claim in place (P6). B is a hue and a tiny target. C makes the reader match numbers by hand.

mark.why: a small round chip raised like a footnote, sized to its number

pop.why: the source card is a level-4 pane held to a reading width

title.why: the source title is semibold at body size

source.why: where the source comes from is secondary, under its title

quote.why: the passage is set off by a hairline rule at its start edge in the divider tone

foot.why: confidence and the link share the last row

link.why: Open source is an underlined link that says it opens a new tab

sr.why: opens in a new tab is read for screen readers

hover.why: the mark lifts to chosen glass under a pointer

data-state=open.why: the mark stays lit while its card is open

focus-visible.why: the focus ring shows on the mark when reached by keyboard

@media forced-colors: active.why: in forced colours the system draws the edges and marks, so every part stays findable
